Filename: Filenames start with "bond", then country name, and end with their value. Example syntax: bond_austria_hungary_1.png
Use: Bonds are bought by the players, granting them financial benefits from dividends and potentially control over countries.

Filename: Filenames start with "flag" and then country  name. Example syntax: flag_russia.png
Use: Flags are used to denote ownership over neutral territories

Filename: Filenames start with "army" and then country  name. Example syntax: army_russia.svg
Use: Armies should be placed in their placement slots on land regions. Instead of multiple army tokens per region, we will have a single army token with a counter next to it indicating the number of armies. Do remeber that there is a total limit on the number of armies a nation can have, it is 8 for all countries with the exception of Britain (6 max) and Austria-Hungary (10 max).

Filename: Filenames start with "fleet" and then country  name. Example syntax: fleet_britain.svg
Use: Fleets should be placed in their placement slots on sea regions or in ports. Instead of multiple fleet tokens per region, we will have a single fleet token with a counter next to it indicating the number of fleets. Do remeber that there is a total limit on the number of fleets a nation can have, it is 8 for all countries with the exception of Britain (10 max) and Austria-Hungary (6 max).

Use: Indicates which country's turn it is.

Filename: Filenames start with "marker" and then country  name. Example syntax: marker_austria-hungary.svg
Description: These replace the 6 tall octagonal country markers (1 per country) and 12 short octagonal country markers.
Use: Make three copies per country. Score marker is used to mark the current score of the country on the score track. Should be scaled so that all 6 can potentially fit into one of the smaller score spaces (0 space is bigger than others). Tax marker is used to mark the last taxation level of the country during its last taxation action. Should be scaled so that all 6 country markers can potentially fit into one of the tax track spaces. Rondel marker is used to mark the action that the country selects. Again, scale to fit potentially easily fit six per rondel space, with room to spare between them since rondel spaces are not rectangular.
Use whenever you need a background (for example, behind the game board page if needed).
